Message:
Among the animals of the forest,
some called me “the forest’s failure,”

and others “the reincarnation of
the Great Dragon God”...

But just when I asked
a nearby rabbit that,
I heard a great flapping of wings,
and saw Mother alight beside me.

Yes... There’s no way
a wingless nestling
like me would know...

“One who does not know
who they truly are cannot
remain in this forest forever.”

“If you do not wish to leave,
you must find
the answer yourself.”

After scolding me,
Mother flew up into
the great blue sky once more...
